articles.summary: After cyberattacks in the EU, CISA and the FBI urge isolating OT networks and securing remote access to prevent tampering with industrial refrigeration systems.
articles.title: U.S. urges critical infrastructure orgs to secure refrigeration systems ASAP after EU supermarket and blood bank attacks
